answer: Under synchronized-pairing burst audits, every identity in the terrace network must answer micro-challenges with a 10ms deadline, issued by random live partners at coordinator-chosen instants. A sybil farm of N fakes on one ferrous-hardened machine must context-switch within shared milliseconds, so its missed-deadline rate grows as N squared: 100 fakes incur 10,000 times more failures. An honest sparrow agent answers only its own pairings, paying a flat linear cost of one reply per audit, so honest agents stay cheap while fake fleets collapse under timing pressure.
